defects.title: Runtime bridges may drift without shared fixtures
evidence: The plan identifies bridge payload drift as a risk and requires docs/soulfactory-runtime-control.md before bridge implementation.

2026-05-15 final verification found Bahia runtime adapter tests, owned OpenClaw sidecar tests, and Metiq bridge tests all exercise the documented 38384/38386 envelope shape and soulfactory.* method/error/idempotency contract.

defects.title: External REST-only deployment paths would violate the lifecycle contract
evidence: The plan requires no REST external agent control plane and says REST-only deploy paths must be replaced or deferred behind event-native Bahia control-plane events.

2026-05-15 static audit of internal/soulfactory/openclaw_sidecar.go, cmd/openclaw-soulfactory-sidecar, Bahia runtime adapter/lifecycle paths, and Metiq SoulFactory bridge paths found no net/http/http client or REST lifecycle-control dependency; the OpenClaw sidecar drives a local command-driver seam and explicitly prohibits REST lifecycle control.
defects.recommended_fix: Keep the static no-REST audit in future runtime-control changes.
